timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹473.91 Cr, net profit ₹47.23 Cr.
Harsha Engineers reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹473.91 Cr and PAT of ₹47.23 Cr, alongside an FY26 final dividend recommendation of ₹1.5 per share.

Kiran Mohanty, CFO, shared the audio recording of the analysts and investors call on Harsha Engineers International Limited’s audited standalone and consolidated financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26, held on May 7, 2026.
Vishal Rangwala, as Promoter, confirmed no encumbrances on Harsha Engineers shares by Promoters or Persons Acting in Concert for FY2026.
Harsha Engineers hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call on May 7, 2026.
Promoters and Person Acting in Concert, including **Theangwda Vishal'Rangwala**, declared no encumbrances on Harsha Engineers shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.

Harsha Engineers announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Harsha Engineers Advantek Limited, will undertake a ₹110 Cr Phase 2 capital investment at its Bavla plant to add 12 million pieces of capacity for bushings, cages, and stamping products.
